title: Unit Event — Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky — Episode4 A Big Step Forward

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky
meta.Event Outline: Feeling the need for further practice leading up to their solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! decide to do a training camp that doubles as a streaming project. They start doing a variety of exercises under a special program devised by Airi, but something seems to be worrying Minori...

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<This is incredible.
They wrote all these comments during your stream?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the thing.
At first, it was just business as usual, but they started coming in so fast partway through that we were having trouble keeping up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And it's clear now that we have quite a few first-time viewers with us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, you're right.
This person said, “Airi sort of vanished from the airwaves after she left QT. I had no idea she was doing stuff online now.”>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<“Shizuku! Haruka! It's been so long!
This takes me back to when I was still an active fan. I'm subscribing to your channel right now!”>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so nice of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You received a lot of comments too, Minori.
This person said, “An A for effort!” And this one said, “This is my first time seeing this girl, but her dedication's really admirable.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I'm so honored...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Also, look... Even though you've paused the stream, plenty of people are still commenting while waiting for it to resume.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Some have even said, “I can wait the two hours”♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow. Despite this being an incredibly long stream, some want to see everything we do during our “nearly 24-hour livestream” in real time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know we're here to train, but we should also do everything we can to give our viewers the content they deserve.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's keep giving it our best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you're more than ready to deliver.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, why don't we end our break here and move on to our next training activity?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Now?
But we just started our break a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, we told everyone that we'd be taking a break for two hours.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Aren't all of you forgetting something really important?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can only practice the dance routine for our new song when our viewers aren't watching, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
We still have to keep that a secret!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try taking a video? That might make it easier for us to objectively analyze everything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, great idea!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, would you and the others mind playing the audience for us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sure! We're gonna get super hyped♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And we'll let you know if we notice anything, so good luck, girls!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
We'll do our best to get it right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Maestro, start the music...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, you're just slightly out of position! Try to keep that in mind when we shuffle around!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Next up is the toughest turn in this entire routine.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This part's been giving me so much trouble... I've got to tense my supporting leg to keep steady and then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's it!
Your core is looking solid, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa, I did it...!
Alright, let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (After this, Shizuku and I are supposed to swap positions. We almost ran right into each other the last time we practiced together in SEKAI, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh, she's making eye contact with me...!
Just like during the watermelon smashing activity...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That means...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice!
That was a really smooth transition, you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wow! It's crystal clear that our training's already paying off! This is incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait, no! I fell behind going into the chorus!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(C-Calm down!
Just try to relax and get back into the rhythm...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Whoa...!
The way Haruka moved her hand just now was so pretty...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I wanna learn how to do that too.
That means I have to keep doing everything I can for our solo show...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Girls, that was unbelievable!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, it really was!
What you showed us in SEKAI the other day was nice, but this was spectacular♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's like you all figured out how to move as a cohesive unit.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I have to think that your training's already paying off, no?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, there's probably still room for improvement, so let's see what the video can tell us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm curious as to how I looked just now, so let's all sit close and watch it together...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll play it now!
Squeeze in, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...!
We all seem to be in sync from the start.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But during the chorus... Here!
I sort of messed up this part...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's so obvious when you watch it on video. And the part when you gracefully move your arm, Haruka, mine looks so heavy and clunky...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, for that part, I try to imagine myself gently reaching up towards the sun to pluck it out of the sky.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Pluck the sun out of the sky...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. There are some tricks involved with doing that, such as engaging your core, but I'm sure you'll figure it out in time for our show as long as you keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. You've improved so much since we met the other day. Even that big turn went really smoothly for you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank you two so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I know I still need to practice more and more, and how mistakes like these can't happen during our very first solo show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right.
So, let's keep doing what we can to really master this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That includes all of us, not just Minori. There's stuff for each of us to work on, so we'll need to do our best to make those fixes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right!
I'll have to try my best to keep up with Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, what's our next step?
We could try breaking the routine into parts to examine things closer. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, before we do, mind if I get something to drink? I sorta already ran through what I brought.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was thinking about checking out that cafe nearby. Actually, why don't we all go there together...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, the place that was selling tropical juice? I've been wondering about it as well after seeing the sign they had out front!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Tropical juice? That sounds yummy...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I bet it's perfect for when you're at the beach! I wanna try it too!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't we get you some after our training camp's over?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?! I can't wait to try it♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's take a quick break and grab ourselves some tropical juice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's all...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, actually, I think I'll pass.
Go on ahead without me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? But...
I thought you also wanted to try their tropical juice, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you're thinking about practicing by yourself, we'll be splitting up for individual work later, so there's really no need for you to push yourself right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Still...
I feel like I'm gonna lose my concentration if I don't work on it now. So, I'll go get some later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can't force you to take a break, but you really should take a quick breather at some point. Also, we can go buy some juice for you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we'll see you in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa... The ocean looks so pretty when you're this close.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You guys haven't really had a chance to soak in the scenery yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it's nice to stop for a moment to actually do that. If I were over there with all of you, I'd probably have dived into the water already to celebrate how summery it is.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I definitely understand how you feel.
Yes, we got to ride on that banana boat, but we haven't really gone swimming yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, to be fair, Minori and I got to after going for a dunk during our turns...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No fair! You and Minori got to go swimming!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I kinda doubt going for a relaxing swim was on Minori's mind at that time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Especially since she was doing everything in her power to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. And now, she's probably working on everything we just mentioned about our dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you sure she's not pushing herself too hard...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get how you feel.
I mean, it's her very first solo show and it's just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, right. Out of all of you girls, Minori's the only one who hasn't done a show like that before...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. And it's going to be a very special moment for her since your first time only happens once during your life...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of that, Minori's lifelong wish has been to become an idol, so this is her dream stage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Right...
And performing in a solo show is one of the most significant milestones for a new idol.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <As such, I suppose it's only natural for her to want all the hard work she's put in up to this point to bear fruit.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me of my first solo show. I remember how my heart began pounding so hard when I stood on stage that I was worried others would hear it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, I also remember having a strong desire to sing and dance in a way that made it so everyone in the audience enjoyed the show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
It's really hard to put that feeling into words, but it's completely unforgettable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Talk about a blast from the past...
I remember being so focused on making sure our show succeeded that I'd stay late to practice every single day.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (After we were done practicing as a group, I kept working on stuff, checking how I looked in the mirror and making fine adjustments because I'd convinced myself that absolutely no mistakes would be allowed.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(So...
Minori's probably feeling the same way right now.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Airi?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, guys...
On second thought, I'm gonna go check up on Minori! I'm sorta worried about her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A-Airi...?!
